Our story

A working foundry, softened into a kitchen

Old Foundry Coffee sits inside a building that once cast iron for the town — now it casts sourdough, salads and slow-roasted coffee instead. The room keeps the bones of its old trade: exposed brick, tall factory windows, and a counter that still feels like it's made for real work.

Everything is cooked to order in the small kitchen out back — the same plate rarely repeats two days running, because it depends on what came in fresh that morning.
